pollster.weighting_quote: Weighted to reflect the modeled likely November 2026 electorate in Iowa. The weights balance gender, age, race, region, urban, suburban and rural community, party registration and 2024 presidential vote (Trump 54%, Harris 43%). Final weights are calibrated to GrayHouse’s political engagement model, so that voters across the full range of turnout propensity are represented in their expected share of the electorate.
